evidence.name: Screen field: Cap on multi-select picks
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Cap on multi-select picks" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Cap on multi-select picks
sections.description: Limits how many items a visitor can choose on a multi-select screen. Set a small cap (e.g. 3) to keep answers focused and the next step manageable; leave it unlimited to let them pick freely. This control only appears on multi-select screens and is ignored everywhere else.
